school: 战国末期楚国诗人、政治家，曾任左徒、三闾大夫，中国浪漫主义文学奠基人
historical_significance: 屈原（约前340-约前278），芈姓屈氏，名平，字原，楚国贵族，战国末期诗人与政治家。早年深得楚怀王信任，任左徒，'入则与王图议国事，出则接遇宾客'，主张对内举贤授能、修明法度，对外联齐抗秦。因上官大夫进谗而见疏，又遭子兰、靳尚集团构陷，先后被流放汉北与江南沅湘之间。前278年秦将白起攻破郢都，屈原于五月初五自沉汨罗江殉国。《离骚》三千七百余句、两千四百余字，是中国古代最长的抒情诗，开创'香草美人'的比兴寄托传统；'路漫漫其修远兮，吾将上下而求索''亦余心之所善兮，虽九死其犹未悔'成为民族精神的原型句。《九歌》《天问》《九章》各具面目：《天问》一口气提出一百七十余问，上考天文、下究历史，是对整个神话-历史叙事体系的总质询。屈原的人格——'举世皆浊我独清，众人皆醉我独醒'——与其作品一道，塑造了此后两千年中国士人的精神坐标：贾谊吊之，司马迁愤之，杜甫法之，鲁迅赞'其影响于后来之文章，乃甚或在三百篇以上'。端午节吃粽子赛龙舟的民俗，即源于人民对这位诗人的永恒纪念。
historical_significance_en: Qu Yuan (c. 340-c. 278 BCE), of the Qu lineage of the Chu royal clan, was a poet and statesman of late Warring States Chu. Early trusted by King Huai as Left Master, drafting decrees and handling foreign guests, he advocated recruiting the worthy and reforming law at home while allying with Qi against Qin abroad. Slandered by the courtier Shangguan and framed by the Zilan-Jinshang faction, he was exiled first to the Han north, then to the Yuan-Xiang region. In 278 BCE, when Qin's general Bai Qi sacked the Chu capital Ying, Qu Yuan drowned himself in the Miluo River on the fifth day of the fifth month. 'Li Sao,' over 2,400 characters, is China's longest lyric poem and founded the allegorical tradition of 'fragrant plants and fair ones'; lines like 'The road is long and far—I will seek high and low' and 'For what my heart holds dear, nine deaths would not make me repent' became archetypal formulas of the national spirit. The 'Nine Songs,' 'Heavenly Questions,' and 'Nine Pieces' each break ground: 'Tian Wen' fires over 170 questions at the entire mythological-historical order. His character—'All the world is muddy and I alone am clear'—together with his works set the spiritual coordinates of Chinese literati for two millennia: Jia Yi mourned him, Sima Qian channeled his indignation, Du Fu took him as model, and Lu Xun judged his influence on later literature perhaps greater than the Book of Songs itself. The Dragon Boat Festival commemorates him to this day.
description_zh: 以生命为修辞的政治诗人：把人格清洁置于生存之上，把对祖国的忠诚写成史诗，在'众人皆醉'的浊世中坚持独醒——用自沉完成对理想的最后作证。
description_en: A political poet who made his life the rhetoric: placing purity of character above survival, writing loyalty to his homeland as epic, holding to solitary wakefulness in a drunken world—sealing his testament to the ideal by his own death.
roles_en: Master of the Three Wards (sanlü dafu)
